mechanism: Naproxen (NSAID) reduces renal perfusion and can impair oxybutynin clearance; oxybutynin's anticholinergic effects may worsen NSAID-induced GI irritation and increase urinary retention risk.
action: Monitor renal function and fluid intake; use lowest effective naproxen dose for shortest duration; consider alternative anticholinergic if prolonged NSAID therapy needed.
